title: 1 Nuke vs 100 Pawns
summary: Second '1 Nuke vs 100 Pawns' video: on a 12x10 blue-grey board Tony's king and Nuke (queen + knight for any distance = queen + knightrider) are boxed in, surrounded by Martin's ~100 pawns, with two black pawns already threatening promotion-mate. He gambles the nuke grabbing pawns while Martin keeps under-promoting (bishops, rooks, sometimes queens), survives with very little mobility and eventually checkmates (~8:50).
rules: Black (Martin): king + ~100 pawns filling most of the board around White.
White: king + one Nuke, fenced in near the bottom-left.
Nuke = queen + knightrider (knight leaps repeated any distance in one line).
Pawns promote on White's back rank to any piece (Martin promotes to bishop/rook/queen).
setup: White king + Nuke bottom-left, enclosed; ~100 black pawns fill the rest including squares one step from promotion (2 immediate promotion threats); Black king among them (exact layout visual-only).
current_impl_issues: Impl 'nuke' foe:pawns on 8x8 with a few ranks of pawns; video is 12x10 with ~100 pawns surrounding the boxed-in White king and immediate promotion threats.
